infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DriveSense requires camera access for the 12-Angle Visual Vehicle Inspection system.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DriveSense needs location access to track real-time driving telemetry and dispatch Emergency Roadside Assistance.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: DriveSense tracks live route telemetry while driving.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DriveSense uses your photo library to attach vehicle documentation and inspection photographs.
